title: Renzo MCP Server
description: MCP server for Renzo protocol data, including chains, vaults, operators, and ezETH metrics.
summary: MCP server for Renzo protocol data, including chains, vaults, operators, and ezETH metrics.
offersHint: MCP server for Renzo protocol data, including chains, vaults, operators, and ezETH metrics. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.renzoprotocol.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: get_supported_chains
toolsPreview.description: List all blockchain networks Renzo operates on, including supported products per chain

toolsPreview.name: get_protocol_stats
toolsPreview.description: Get aggregate Renzo protocol statistics: total TVL, per-ecosystem TVL, APRs, and supported chain count

toolsPreview.name: get_ezeth_info
toolsPreview.description: Get current ezETH metrics: APR, total supply, TVL, price, and exchange rate

toolsPreview.name: get_operators
toolsPreview.description: List Renzo protocol operators, optionally filtered by product (ezETH, pzETH, ezSOL, etc.)

toolsPreview.name: get_vaults
toolsPreview.description: List Renzo vaults with current TVL and APR, optionally filtered by ecosystem (eigenlayer, symbiotic, jito, generic)

toolsPreview.name: get_vault_details
toolsPreview.description: Get detailed information for a specific Renzo vault, including daily TVL snapshots, operators, and strategy parameters (current LTV, target LTV, max LTV) for reserve vaults. Pass a vault address or symbol (e.g. 'ezREZ', 'ezCompETH1').

toolsPreview.name: get_vault_strategy
toolsPreview.description: Get the strategy and AVS (Actively Validated Service) allocations for an EigenLayer vault. Shows where the vault's capital is deployed, how much is staked in each AVS, and which operators run the infrastructure. Supports ezETH, ezEIGEN, and ezREZ.

toolsPreview.name: get_token_balances
toolsPreview.description: Get a user's Renzo token balances on Ethereum mainnet (ezETH, pzETH, vault LP tokens) with ETH and USD values. Pass an Ethereum address.

toolsPreview.name: get_withdrawal_requests
toolsPreview.description: Get a user's pending ezETH withdrawal requests from the WithdrawQueue contract, including amounts, claimability status, and time remaining. Pass an Ethereum address.
